parameters.name: AppName
parameters.description: The name of the application to which the live stream belongs. This parameter is determined by you.

parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The domain name used for stream pulling. It is the main streaming domain.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The time when stream pulling ends.

The time range specified by the StartTime and EndTime parameters cannot exceed seven days. The time specified by the EndTime parameter must be later than the current time. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z format. The time must be in UTC.

parameters.name: SourceUrl
parameters.description:
The origin URL of the live stream. You can specify multiple URLs. Separate them with semicolons (;).

>  You can pull only live streams in the Real-Time Messaging Protocol (RTMP), Flash Video (FLV), HTTP Live Streaming (HLS), and Secure Reliable Transport (SRT) formats.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The time when stream pulling starts.

The time range specified by the StartTime and EndTime parameters cannot exceed seven days. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z format. The time must be in UTC.

parameters.name: StreamName
parameters.description: The name of the live stream. This parameter is determined by you.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live add-live-pull-stream-info-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --app-name liveApp0000 --stream-name liveStream0000 --source-url rtmp://guide.aliyundoc.com/liveApp0000/liveStream0000_rtmp://developer.aliyundoc.com/liveApp0000/liveStream0000 --start-time 2017-12-21T08:00:00Z --end-time 2017-12-22T08:00:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live AddLivePullStreamInfoConfig --region cn-hangzhou --SourceUrl 'rtmp://guide.aliyundoc.com/liveApp0000/liveStream0000_rtmp://developer.aliyundoc.com/liveApp0000/liveStream0000' --StreamName liveStream0000 --EndTime '2017-12-22T08:00:00Z' --DomainName 'example.com' --StartTime '2017-12-21T08:00:00Z' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --AppName liveApp0000
